EXCEPT WITH REGARD TO OBLIGATIONS TO INDEMNIFY A PARTY FOR CLAIMS MADE BY THIRD PARTIES, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY (OR ITS AFFILIATES) PURSUANT TO THIS AGREEMENT FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, OR SPECIAL DAMAGES OR LOSSES OR ANY PUNITIVE, EXEMPLARY, TREBLE, OR SIMILAR DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE PERFORMANCE OF, OR FAILURE TO PERFORM, ITS OBLIGATIONS HEREUNDER, EVEN IF SUCH DAMAGES OR LOSSES ARE CAUSED BY THE SOLE, JOINT, OR CONCURRENT NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR OTHER FAULT OF THE PARTY WHOSE LIABILITY IS BEING WAIVED HEREBY.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, Shipper may withhold payment of amounts it disputes in good faith, provided that if any such amount is later determined to have been due Transporter Section 10.2 below shall apply to such amount.
findings.explanation: As the service provider performing transportation services, allowing Shipper to unilaterally withhold payment for any good-faith disputed amounts creates cash flow uncertainty and shifts the burden onto Transporter to recover funds.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the right to withhold payment for disputed amounts, requiring Shipper to pay invoices in full and submit disputes for resolution post-payment, or require disputed amounts to be placed into an escrow account.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT WITH REGARD TO OBLIGATIONS TO INDEMNIFY A PARTY FOR CLAIMS MADE BY THIRD PARTIES, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY (OR ITS AFFILIATES) PURSUANT TO THIS AGREEMENT FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, OR SPECIAL DAMAGES OR LOSSES OR ANY PUNITIVE, EXEMPLARY, TREBLE, OR SIMILAR DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE PERFORMANCE OF, OR FAILURE TO PERFORM, ITS OBLIGATIONS HEREUNDER, EVEN IF SUCH DAMAGES OR LOSSES ARE CAUSED BY THE SOLE, JOINT, OR CONCURRENT NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR OTHER FAULT OF THE PARTY WHOSE LIABILITY IS BEING WAIVED HEREBY.
findings.explanation: While indirect and consequential damages are mutually waived, the explicit carve-out for third-party indemnification claims means Transporter's liability for third-party claims remains completely uncapped, exposing Transporter to potentially catastrophic financial risk.
findings.suggested_change: Establish a clear overall aggregate cap on liability, including third-party indemnification obligations, capped at the total fees received by Transporter under the Agreement over a 12-month period.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for providing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to suggest a couple of revisions before we proceed. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment disputes, the agreement permits withholding funds for disputed amounts, which creates cash flow uncertainty. I propose modifying this so that invoices are paid in full and disputes are resolved post-payment. - Regarding the relevant clause on indemnification, the exception for third-party claims leaves liability uncapped. I propose establishing a clear aggregate cap on liability that includes these claims. Thank you for your consideration, and I look forward to signing soon.
